I asked Claude Code to open a vault with no password and no source code. It opened it in five steps, all on screen: what the binary gives away, where it decides, the ten-byte table, the XOR undone letter by letter, and the vault open.

Everything on screen is real output of file, strings and objdump. Nothing else.

Only on your own binary, or a CTF. Code and binary at github.com/ViniciusKoiti/baixo-nivel-demos

Presenter drawn from my photos; voice cloned by AI.
